principles: Aluminium alloys generally do not possess a true endurance limit analogous to the idealised steel S-N plateau; fatigue strength should therefore be represented at a specified cycle count.
Surface finish, mean stress, stress concentration, corrosion environment, residual stress, joining method and product form materially affect fatigue performance.
Wrought and cast products should not share a single fatigue allowables record.
Welded aluminium requires a joint/detail-class approach rather than parent-material fatigue strength.
